endpoint_semantics.reference: close of bar opened at release minus one minute and available at release
endpoint_semantics.five_minutes: close of bar opened at release plus four minutes and available at release plus five minutes
endpoint_semantics.fifteen_minutes: close of bar opened at release plus fourteen minutes and available at release plus fifteen minutes
endpoint_semantics.sixty_minutes: close of bar opened at release plus fifty-nine minutes and available at release plus sixty minutes

fundamental_identity: one point-in-time standardized gold-direction value per unique release component and source value ID; duplicated algorithm-version calculations are not separate economic components
market_vote: sign of the sum of nonzero five-minute ZT, ZN and EURUSD close changes; all three required; any ZT or ZN instrument-ID change makes the vote unknown
eligibility: F equals M equals G, with exact endpoints and a nonflat primary outcome

statistics.primary: signed XAUUSD close displacement from release plus five minutes to release plus fifteen minutes
statistics.consistency: signed XAUUSD close displacement from release plus five minutes to release plus sixty minutes
statistics.direction_balanced_hit_rate: mean of bullish-prediction and bearish-prediction hit rates
statistics.bootstrap: calendar-month block resampling with replacement; 20000 samples; linear 5th and 95th percentiles
statistics.permutation: shuffle primary outcome signs against fixed predictions within each separately reported calendar segment; one-sided; 50000 permutations
